# Brossa

[![Build status](https://badge.buildkite.com/c0f5b57036696008a4ddb79458afd717ecb4e1a5783a9be89e.svg?branch=master)](https://buildkite.com/artificialio/brossa)

Additional documentation is published [in our GitBook organisation](https://app.gitbook.com/o/cgDp7rGA012sSc8t97yL/home).

## 1. Setup

### 1.1. Prerequisites

There are a few things to take care of before you clone the repo.

#### Get 1Password access

A few of the steps below require secrets, which are stored in the "Brossa" vault in 1Password. If you don't have access, ask Zsolt to add you to this vault.

#### Install the latest macOS

Make sure to start this whole process by updating to the latest macOS. We had some weird issues in the past with eg. network connection, that went away when upgrading.

#### Install a terminal

Download and install [Cursor](https://www.cursor.com/) to use as your terminal for completing the setup steps.
MacOS has a built-in [Terminal](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/terminal/welcome/mac). If you prefer, there are many great 3rd party ones like [iTerm2](https://iterm2.com/), [Alacritty](https://alacritty.org/) and [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/).
